messages:
ae_olivia: Quick help please — SynEvo POC (Sam) seeing TTFT spikes 200ms -> 1.1s for small prompts. Also 429s when they ramp to ~15rps. Demo tomorrow AM. Can we triage?
se_marco: Thanks. Can you paste a trace id and which deployment? Dedicated or Hosted?
ae_olivia: trace: 20260410T11:07Z/tx-9f7; model=open-redwood/gptj-6b-quant; deployment=dedicated-synevo-us-central.
eng_oncall_tai: Looking at tx-9f7 — logs show many kvcache_miss for key=ctx:synevo:conv and batching shows queued=4 window_ms=60. Also a couple of 'shard_busy' before a 429. Snippet: 
``
WARN prefetch: kvcache_miss key=ctx:synevo:conv:id123
INFO batching: queued=4 window_ms=60
ERROR shard: shard_busy in_flight=32 limit=32
```
eng_runtime_kim: Two quick actions: 1) prefill the most common ctx prefixes, 2) lower batch_window_ms for syn evo route to 10ms so interactive requests aren't waiting.
se_marco: I can run a small prefill job. Example: curl internal/prefill (ops token) with key ctx:synevo:conv payload '<warm>' x6.
eng_oncall_tai: I launched prefill job pf-421 and set a temporary metric prefetch_miss_rate. Also bumped shard concurrency limit from 32->48 for prod-sim POC (op id thr-132).
scale-bot: scaled dedicated-pool/dedicated-synevo-us-central by +1 GPU (new size 5) — event s-992
eng_runtime_kim: Also changed route profile to interactive (batch_window_ms=10, max_batch=4) for that deployment.
sec_amir: SynEvo legal asked about audit log retention and encryption-at-rest. I'll send the redacted KMS and retention doc. @ae_olivia plz share their security contact.
finance_zoe: For pricing: 5-GPU dedicated POC guidance ~$24k/mo baseline. If they want guaranteed demo capacity we can propose a short-term reserved add-on for the demo day (~$1.5k for the week).
customer_sam: Did the prefill and route tweak. TTFT dropped to ~160ms median and demo flow looks smooth. Still saw a single 429 during a big spike but much better. Thanks!
se_marco: I'll keep the prefetch_miss alert at live and monitor 'shard_busy' counts. If we see repeat 429s we'll add a short ingress ramp policy.
ae_olivia: Great work. We'll document recommended kvcache TTL and route config in the POC notes and follow up on pricing/security next. Closing for now unless something else pops up.
